description: Tim Rogers wants to eliminate Property Taxes across the country. This will impact all American citizens in a positive way. This is why I want to go to Congress, to fight for the People. I also want to eliminate the 16th Amendment, Income Tax. We the People have been over taxed in this country. It is time that we stand up for our Rights as Americans. If you like these ideas, Vote Tim Rogers for Congress. If you have any questions, reach out and we can explain the impact that this will have.
